_comment: Greenvale village prop kit for the vertical slice (brief sections 69 and 90).
Subjects only. Art direction lives in Tools/hollowasset/style.py so the whole
kit can be restyled from one place. Region sets the texture palette.
Regenerate a single entry with: generate <this file> --id <asset id>
'surface' names painted colour and painted marks, never a material sample.
Under docs/ANIME_DIRECTION.md rule 3 a texture carries hue, not light and not
photography, and words like 'wood grain', 'weathered' or 'moss' are requests
for a photograph: the crate that came back photoreal and the tree that came
back on a grass disc were both asked for exactly that. See ASSET_PIPELINE.md,
